title: ParseRubricOutput
description: What Claude returns when it reads a marking rubric or assignment brief (spec F-14). Used as the structured-output format of the parse_rubric job.

is_rubric.description: False when the document is not a rubric or brief (for example meeting minutes).

weight_unit.description: How the document states weights. 'none' means it gives no weights and the weights below are suggestions.

weight.description: As written in the document (percent or points); a suggested percentage when weight_unit is 'none'.

notes.description: Short note for the student about anything uncertain, or an empty string.
